summary_md: **gj0xv ([@gj0xv](https://x.com/gj0xv/status/2115813406108451022))** built **skill-issue**, a local harness that runs the same task twice from identical files, with and without a Claude Code skill, and has a separate verifier judge both runs to see whether the skill helps or just consumes context ([Gjusev/skill-issue](https://github.com/Gjusev/skill-issue)).
